facts.hands-face: A person who has sat up in bed covers the face with both hands.
facts.nine-swords: Nine swords hang side by side, horizontally, on a black wall.
facts.not-pierced: The swords do not touch the body and only hang on the wall.
facts.quilt: The quilt is painted with red roses and constellation signs in turn.
facts.carving: A scene of one person striking down another is carved on the side panel of the bed.

glosses.not-pierced: The fear does not actually touch; it hangs large inside the head.
glosses.quilt: Roses that remain even on the quilt covering the night.

reversedGloss.waning: Anxiety thins little by little, as the night passes.
reversedGloss.internalized: The worry cannot be told to anyone and is swallowed alone.
reversedGloss.excess: Anxiety grows and shakes even daily life.

misdescriptions.wrong: The swords are stabbing the person.
